test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/892e441f3b9f19d73e84f4adbfdd2b7c99ed17fc130be01c1a358e50bc136577.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately top element and center element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately bottom elements, center left element and center right element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27b241e8ef27dc21e9a3807cf003624a4c9d96b068ef374780debcd2ef998b57.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately top left corner, center left element and center right element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately center element and bottom elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b953390d3f4b8b11f3e9fa97a9f54f9fb8d7d5ef222aad7350577b8b5c8d9fc0.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8281e80d58ab1db1e9d1a738fd0d40a323ae162280872f019e96add7d0976a49.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
